# Healthcare Database

This folder catalogs specific data variables used to extract, filter, and define patient populations within the Danish Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen). The pages detail how hospital-level encounters are identified, how time periods are delimited, and how the core cohort of operated patients is formally defined. Each variable's application is directly traced to the database's official methodology and reporting guidelines.

## Pages

- [[forloeb-sorkode|Forloeb_SORKode]] — Identifies the hospital-level course or encounter code used for data extraction.
- [[opereret-1|Opereret = 1]] — Defines the core patient population that possesses both an inclusion diagnosis and a recorded operation.
- [[t-0|T_0]] — Specifies the variable used for period delimitation when extracting time-bound data from the database.
